question.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & -3 \\ -2 & 3 & 6 \\ 2 & -2 & -5\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,A-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
A-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-\lambda  & -2 & -3 \\ -2 & 3-\lambda  & 6 \\ 2 & -2 & -5-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(A-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Expanding the determinant across the $1$st row, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-\lambda  & -2 & -3 \\ -2 & 3-\lambda  & 6 \\ 2 & -2 & -5-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ -\lambda |\begin{aligned}3-\lambda  & 6 \\ -2 & -5-\lambda \end{aligned}|-(-2)|\begin{aligned}-2 & 6 \\ 2 & -5-\lambda \end{aligned}|+(-3)|\begin{aligned}-2 & 3-\lambda  \\ 2 & -2\end{aligned}| & =0 \\ -\lambda ({\lambda }^{2}+2\lambda -3)+2(2\lambda -2)-3(2\lambda -2) & =0 \\ (-{\lambda }^{3}-2{\lambda }^{2}+3\lambda )+(4\lambda -4)-(6\lambda -6) & =0 \\ -{\lambda }^{3}-2{\lambda }^{2}+\lambda +2 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{3}+2{\lambda }^{2}-\lambda -2 & =0\end{aligned}
$$
